notify_on_copy.description: Show a notification when a character is copied to the clipboard
notify_on_copy.label: Notify on Copy

paste_delay_ms.description: Wait this long after the launcher closes before pasting, so focus has returned to the previous window
paste_delay_ms.label: Paste Delay (ms)

paste_mode.description: Also paste into the focused window after copying. Uses wtype. "Type the character" avoids paste shortcuts entirely and works in both terminals and GUI apps.
paste_mode.label: Paste After Copy
